question: Can the deterministic mid-route cancellation test plus QA pre-abort proof satisfy the real-behavior gate for this internal race, or is redacted live installed-binding proof required before merge?
rationale: The contributor's evidence says the route and binding store are mocked in the central race; repository source and the fresh merge result could not be inspected to independently decide whether that is an adequate substitute.

options.title: Require live binding proof
options.body: Keep the proof gate until a redacted installed-binding run demonstrates cancellation during routed delivery.

options.title: Grant a proof override
options.body: Accept the deterministic race coverage as sufficient for this timing-dependent internal invariant.

recommendation.title: Require live binding proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proof gate until a redacted installed-binding run demonstrates cancellation during routed delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The provided context identifies this person as the author of the merged refactor that owns the reviewed delivery split.
